select count(id) from orders
and status = #{status}
select date_format(order_time, '%Y-%m-%d') as orderDate, count(id) as orderCount from orders where order_time >= #{begin} and order_time <= #{end} group by date_format(order_time, '%Y-%m-%d')

select od.name as name, sum(od.number) as number from order_detail od inner join orders o on od.order_id = o.id where o.status = #{status} and o.order_time >= #{begin} and o.order_time <= #{end} group by od.name order by number desc limit 10
